# DFT SJT Mock Question Bank

> Free, unofficial practice for the Dental Foundation Training (DFT) situational judgement test: 288 original questions with drag-to-rank answers, a timed 56-question mock, near-miss scoring and a pattern guide. The app itself runs in the browser and needs JavaScript; the teaching material is also published as plain pages.

## Read these
- [Topics covered](https://sajeev2112.github.io/dft-sjt-mock/topics.html): the 12 themes, 4 skill areas and 3 question formats.
- [Pattern guide](https://sajeev2112.github.io/dft-sjt-mock/pattern-guide.html): how the test works and how answers are keyed (priority order, escalation ladder, traps, technique).
- [Theme playbooks](https://sajeev2112.github.io/dft-sjt-mock/playbooks.html): what usually ranks high and low in each theme.

## Notes
- Unofficial and not affiliated with NHS England, COPDEND, HEIW or NIMDTA. The keys are reasoned judgements, not official answers.
- The practice app: https://sajeev2112.github.io/dft-sjt-mock/
- Source code: https://github.com/sajeev2112/dft-sjt-mock
